CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turns_task_position ON turns(task_id, turn_index)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turns_task_files ON turns(task_id, files_modified, files_created)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turns_task_answered ON turns(task_id) WHERE response IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turns_task_unanswered ON turns(task_id) WHERE response IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_evals_task_metric_recent ON evals(task_id, metric, created_at DESC, score)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_runs_empty_open ON runs(started_at, id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND task_prompt IS NULL

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_unjudged_queue ON tasks(ended_at DESC, id, run_id, task_category) WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT (composite_score IS NOT NULL OR summary IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (notes_json IS NOT NULL AND notes_json LIKE '%"notGradeable"%')
